頻率筆記改寫自創辦人 Molly 2025–2026 年在 Threads 連載: Frequency Notes are adapted from Frequency Truths, the series founder Molly published on Threads in 2025–2026. This is the version written for everyone, translated from Chinese.
一篇只講一件事：情緒、直覺、敏感、關係、累。每篇附一個今天就能試的小練習。: Each note is about one thing: emotions, intuition, sensitivity, relationships, tiredness, with a small practice you can try today.
情緒不是麻煩，是訊號: Emotions aren't a problem. They're signals.
很多人把情緒當成要處理掉的麻煩。: Many of us treat emotions as a problem to get rid of.
直覺不是猜對，是你本來就有的導航: Intuition isn't guessing. It's the compass you already have.
直覺不是運氣，也不是憑空亂猜。: Intuition isn't luck, and it isn't a wild guess.
直覺不是運氣，也不是憑空亂猜。它是你過去所有的經驗，在一瞬間給出的判斷。: Intuition isn't luck, and it isn't a wild guess. It's everything you've ever experienced, giving you a judgment in a single moment.
敏感，是感知比較細。: Being sensitive means you perceive in finer detail.
敏感，是感知比較細。你會覺得累、覺得痛，常常是因為你用很細的耳朵，待在一個很吵的: Being sensitive means you perceive in finer detail. When you feel tired or hurt, it's often because you're listening with very fine ears in a very noisy place.
你不是卡住，是不想再走回舊路: You're not stuck. You just don't want the old road.
有時候你會懷疑自己：「是不是又退步了？怎麼什麼都動不了？」: Sometimes you wonder, "Am I going backwards? Why can't I move at all?"
安全感，是知道自己在走自己的路: Safety is knowing you're on your own path
你不是沒有安全感。: It isn't that you lack a sense of safety.
你不是沒有安全感。你可能只是還在照著別人設計的版本過日子。: It isn't that you lack a sense of safety. You may simply still be living a version someone else designed for you.
你不需要先「值得」，才能被愛: You don't have to be "worthy" to be loved
「你要夠好，才值得被愛。」: "You have to be good enough to deserve love."
「你要夠好，才值得被愛。」很多人從小就把這句話放進心裡，然後用一輩子去證明。: "You have to be good enough to deserve love." Many of us took this sentence in as children and spent our lives trying to prove it.
「大家都這樣」，不代表適合你: "Everyone does it" doesn't mean it fits you
當你開始用「大家都這樣」來決定自己怎麼走，你就把方向盤交給了別人。: When you start deciding your path by "everyone does it", you hand the steering wheel to someone else.
好的陪伴，是讓你越來越不需要它: Good support makes you need it less and less
很多課程、很多老師，一開始說要帶你找回自己，最後卻變成你離不開他。: Many courses and teachers promise to help you find yourself, and end up making you unable to leave them.
「愛就是要為對方犧牲。」: "Love means sacrificing yourself for the other person."
「愛就是要為對方犧牲。」這句話聽起來很美，卻讓很多人以為，痛苦才代表愛得夠深。: "Love means sacrificing yourself for the other person." It sounds beautiful, but it leads many of us to believe that pain is proof of deep love.
你這麼容易累，是因為接收得太多: You tire easily because you take in so much
你這麼容易累，不一定是力氣不夠。: If you get tired easily, it isn't necessarily that you lack energy.
